description: This file defines internal type support functions for the Gomega matchers package, including type checks, conversions, and utility functions for reflection-based type assertions.

methods.name: isBool
methods.description: Checks if the provided value is of boolean type.

methods.name: isNumber
methods.description: Checks if the provided value is a numeric type (int, float).

methods.name: isInteger
methods.description: Checks if the provided value is an integer type.

methods.name: isUnsignedInteger
methods.description: Checks if the provided value is an unsigned integer type.

methods.name: isFloat
methods.description: Checks if the provided value is a float type.

methods.name: toInteger
methods.description: Converts a numeric value to int64.

methods.name: toUnsignedInteger
methods.description: Converts a numeric value to uint64.

methods.name: toFloat
methods.description: Converts a numeric value to float64.

methods.name: isError
methods.description: Checks if the value implements the error interface.

methods.name: isChan
methods.description: Checks if the value is a channel.

methods.name: isMap
methods.description: Checks if the value is a map.

methods.name: isArrayOrSlice
methods.description: Checks if the value is an array or slice.

methods.name: isString
methods.description: Checks if the value is a string.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Converts a value to string if possible, returning the string and a boolean indicating success.

methods.name: lengthOf
methods.description: Returns the length of the value if it is a collection or string.

methods.name: capOf
methods.description: Returns the capacity of the value if it is an array, slice, or channel.

methods.name: isNil
methods.description: Checks if the value is nil.
